audit_items.proof_trace: Fork digest incorporates blob parameters via XOR with hash(blob_entry.epoch || max_blobs_per_block). However, blob_entry is derived from config.blob_schedule which has no network-wide consistency validation. If operators configure different blob_schedule entries or rely on different fallback defaults (electra_fork_epoch, max_blobs_per_block_electra), nodes compute different fork digests for the same epoch, causing silent network partition.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker distributes modified chain configs with different blob_schedule entries to a subset of operators. When Fulu activates, these nodes compute different fork digests, partition from the main network, and can be fed alternative chain data without detection.
